# Assets and their licences

Every image, sound and model shipped in the app is listed here with its source and licence.
**Never commit copyrighted music.** All art and audio below is project-owned: generated by scripts written for this project (no samples, no existing works), so there is nothing to license from anyone else. Nila may replace any of it; when she does, update this table.
